name: Order Form from Party List
description: The Platform Order Form with its parties picked, not typed: the rep picks the customer from Counterparties.csv and our signing entity from Internal Entities.csv (assets/clm-data-files), and 22 fields fill from the two rows (legal names, addresses, customer number, currency, payment terms, both signers). The merge tags are the Platform Order Form's, so it launches the same Generated Order Approval. Opened from the Actions menu's New order form (assets/clm-custom-actions/specs/new-order-form.json).

fields.label: Master Agreement
fields.help: The master agreement this order is placed under, with its date, e.g. Platform MSA dated 14 March 2023.

fields.label: Total Order Value
fields.help: Users x price x term. Over 1,000,000 goes to the VP of Sales and the CFO.

fields.label: One-Time Implementation Fee
fields.help: Yes adds a dated one-time fee for onboarding the users above (Agreement Manager's AI tracks it as a one-time payment obligation).

fields.label: Implementation Fee Due Date
fields.help: A business day; with Net 90, 90 days after the Order Effective Date.

fields.label: Customer Termination for Convenience
fields.help: Yes lets the customer end this order on 90 days' written notice.

template: This Order Form is entered into by {{Legal Entity}} ("Provider") and {{Customer Legal Name}}, {{Customer Street}}, {{Customer City}} {{Customer State}} {{Customer Postal Code}}, {{Customer Country}} ("Customer"), under the {{Master Agreement}} (the "Agreement"). Terms not defined here have the meanings given in the Agreement.
Customer number {{Customer Number}}. Provider: {{Legal Entity}} ({{Entity Jurisdiction}}), {{Entity Street}}, {{Entity City}} {{Entity Postal Code}}, {{Entity Country}}.
1. Subscription. Provider grants Customer access to its platform for {{Users}} named users for {{Term in Months}} months from {{Order Effective Date}} (the "Subscription Term").
2. Fees. The fee is {{Currency}} {{Price per User per Month}} per user per month, {{Currency}} {{Total Order Value}} for the Subscription Term, invoiced annually in advance.
3. Payment. Each invoice is payable {{Payment Terms Days}} days from the invoice date. Undisputed amounts more than 30 days overdue accrue interest at 1% per month.
4. Additional users. If Customer's active users exceed the number above for three consecutive months, Customer will place an order for the higher quantity at the same price per user.

template.text: 5. Data protection. Provider will process Customer Personal Data only under a Data Processing Addendum signed by the parties before any Customer Personal Data is processed under this Order Form.
5. Data protection. Provider processes Customer Personal Data under the Data Processing Addendum the parties have already signed.
6. Governing law. This Order Form is governed by the law that governs the Agreement.
6. Data location. Customer Data is stored and processed in the European Union, and the Agreement's data protection terms apply under the GDPR. This Order Form is governed by the laws of Ireland.
6. Governing law. This Order Form is governed by the laws of England and Wales.

6. Data location. Customer Data is stored and processed in the European Union, and the Agreement's data protection terms apply under the GDPR. This Order Form is governed by the laws of the Federal Republic of Germany, and the courts of Munich have exclusive jurisdiction.

template: 7. Order of precedence. This Order Form is subject to the Agreement. If they conflict, this Order Form governs for the subscription it describes.

template.text: 8. Implementation fee. Customer will pay Provider a one-time implementation fee of {{Currency}} {{Implementation Fee}}, due on {{Implementation Fee Due Date}}, for onboarding the users above.
9. Termination for convenience. Customer may terminate this Order Form for convenience on 90 days' written notice to Provider.
